targets.authors: Lin, W. M., FitzGibbon, L., Theobald, M., Breitwieser, J., Brod, G., Murayama, K., & Sakaki, M.
targets.title: The dynamic interplay between goal setting, performance, and emotions in self-regulated learning: A computational modeling approach.
targets.evidence_quote: We reanalyzed the publicly available Study 1 data from Lin et al. (2026).
targets.outcome_computational_quote: Our Stan implementation differed only in computational details, most notably the use of a non-centered parameterization to improve sampling efficiency; the underlying mathematical model is equivalent, and the recovered parameter estimates closely reproduced the original results.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: We reanalyze the Study 1 data by introducing a log(trial) learning curve into the best-fitting model. The negative emotion-to-performance effect is no longer credible in this extended model; instead, a strong practice effect emerges.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Equivalent original models recover the original estimates; adding a practice curve removes the credible negative emotion effect, and time-respecting validation challenges original model selection.

reasoning: Version 1 downloaded from its OSF primary file and verified against assigned title and sole author. Original-data reanalysis of Study 1 only; Study 2 is discussed but explicitly not analyzed.
